headline: 226 photos uploaded in 10 minutes by Collector & District Magistrate
reasons: 226 different photos for 145 different works were uploaded by Collector & District Magistrate within 10 minutes, from 2026-05-28 05:24:40 to 2026-05-28 05:34:36.
That is about one work every 4 seconds on average.
The works are in 4 villages: Adejhar, Bhaisbor, Kherthadih, Talgaon.
These works are spread over 2 blocks: Balod, Dondi.
